tasks.title: Core value types: Suit, Rank, Card, PileID, DrawMode, CardBack, GameState (named fields), TerminalState, WinSummary
acceptance_criteria: Card.id is a computed property, not stored, verified by a test that mutates isFaceUp and asserts id is unchanged
GameState uses named fields (stock, waste, foundations: [Suit:[Card]], tableau: [[Card]]), never a PileID-keyed dictionary
Round-trip Codable unit test passes for GameState with a non-trivial mid-game board

tasks.title: Move validation core: Move, MoveOutcome, canMove/attemptMove including tableau run relocation
acceptance_criteria: Single shared validation path used for single-card and multi-card run moves, no duplicated legality logic
Foundation moves enforce ascending same-suit; tableau moves enforce alternating-color descending; only Kings placeable into empty tableau columns
Unit tests cover single-destination auto-execute, multi-destination ambiguous, and zero-destination blocked outcomes

tasks.title: InteractionState FSM and selection/ambiguity resolution
acceptance_criteria: InteractionState is the sole source of truth for idle/sourceSelected/resolvingMove/dealing/terminal
State transitions are unit-tested for every MoveOutcome case

tasks.title: Undo stack: GameStateSnapshot, capped-200 LIFO, integrated into save/restore
acceptance_criteria: Push on every settled mutation, pop restores exact prior GameState including face-up/face-down state
Stack caps at 200 entries, oldest evicted first, no redo mechanism present anywhere

tasks.title: DrawOneStuckDetector: exact static legality pass
acceptance_criteria: StuckDetector protocol defined; DrawOneStuckDetector never false-positives on a randomized fuzz suite of 10,000+ legal-move sequences
No stock-recycle simulation present, per locked design

tasks.title: DrawThreeStuckDetector: conservative approximation + adversarial fixtures
acceptance_criteria: Hand-constructed adversarial fixture suite (board with exactly one legal move buried in a specific stock-cycle position) passes with zero false-stuck results
Documented in code comments as a conservative approximation distinct from draw-1's exact pass

tasks.title: RestoreIntegrityService: post-decode semantic validation
acceptance_criteria: Rejects a decodable board with duplicate cards, missing ranks-per-suit, illegal stacking, or non-monotonic foundations, returning invalid(reason:)
Unit tests use hand-crafted corrupt-but-decodable fixtures, not just malformed JSON

tasks.title: GameEngine assembly: bootstrap, newGame (RNG seam), selectCard, attemptMove, drawFromStock, undo, setDrawMode, timer, flushPersistence
acceptance_criteria: Public API matches interfaces-json signature exactly; this file is frozen for other lanes to consume via @Environment, not edit
newGame defaults to SystemRandomNumberGenerator in every production call site; injectable rng parameter is unreachable from any UI code path
Timer starts strictly on first confirmed move or stock draw, never on selection/deal/app-open

tasks.title: Domain unit + randomized fuzz/invariant test suite
acceptance_criteria: Fuzz suite asserts 52 unique cards always accounted for, foundation ranks never exceed King, stuck never fires while a legal move exists, run for both draw modes
Full undo-then-redo-of-play (exact state restoration) covered for multi-step sequences

tasks.title: AtomicFileWriter (temp-write-then-swap)
acceptance_criteria: Write failure mid-operation never leaves a truncated/corrupt file at the target path
Unit test simulates a kill between temp-write and swap and asserts the prior file is untouched

tasks.title: PersistenceStore protocol, RestoreOutcome, PersistenceError
acceptance_criteria: load() returns RestoreOutcome<Model> directly, never throws
Three cases (restored/fallbackDefault/dataLoss) all constructible and unit-testable independently

tasks.title: GameSaveStore actor: load/save/flush, debounce 300-500ms floor, integrity validation on load
acceptance_criteria: load() calls RestoreIntegrityService.validate before returning .restored; semantic failure maps to .dataLoss, never silently resumed
save() debounced with write-coalescing; flush() bypasses debounce for the background-transition path
Debounce constant documented as a floor per DEC-project_plan-005, not silently lowered

tasks.title: StatsLogStore actor: two-case event stream + incrementally-updated DrawModeStats cache
acceptance_criteria: gameStarted written durably at session start, before any moves; gameEnded written on completion/abandonment
append() updates the raw event log and the relevant DrawModeStats cache atomically in one write, never drifting

tasks.title: SettingsStore actor
acceptance_criteria: Independent atomic write/read from GameSave and StatsLog; a corrupt Settings.json cannot block either of the other two files from loading

tasks.title: AppRestoreCoordinator: concurrent 3-file load, single hasFinishedInitialLoad gate
acceptance_criteria: All three stores load concurrently (async let), hasFinishedInitialLoad flips exactly once
No per-tab loading state exists anywhere in the codebase

tasks.title: HapticsService implementation
acceptance_criteria: moveAccepted/blockedMove/stockDraw/undo/won/stuckDetected each call the correct generator type (rigid impact for blocked, notification success/warning reserved for win/stuck only)
Single call site — no haptic trigger exists anywhere outside this file

tasks.title: Persistence + lifecycle test suite: corrupt/invalid fixtures, timer-freeze-before-flush ordering
acceptance_criteria: Corrupt-JSON and semantically-invalid-but-decodable fixtures both resolve to .dataLoss with a reason
Test proves elapsedSeconds is frozen before GameSaveStore.flush() fires on a simulated scenePhase background transition

tasks.title: Project scaffolding, module skeleton, CI dependency-lint gate, themed LaunchScreen shell
acceptance_criteria: Project builds and runs to a blank card-table-colored (not white) screen with zero warnings
CI step fails the build if any non-Apple SwiftPM package reference exists in project.pbxproj
Folder skeleton matches the locked module layout exactly, no extra top-level folders

tasks.title: Theme.swift: type scale, spacing, radii, light/dark Scene color roles, fixed card-color constants
acceptance_criteria: Every token from design_handoff's numeric spec is present; zero font/size/color/radius literals permitted anywhere else in the view layer (enforced by T-030's static check)
Card front/back/ink colors are single fixed constants with no light/dark variant pair

tasks.title: Bespoke CardGlyphs: embossed rank/suit Shape library
acceptance_criteria: All 13 ranks x 4 suits render as distinct vector Shapes, no SF Symbols reused as suit glyphs
Glyph zone is flat, high-contrast, free of texture/gradient/specular treatment per locked design constraint

tasks.title: CardView renderer + CardVisualState + cardWidth formula
acceptance_criteria: Single renderer handles face-up, face-down, selected, legalDestination, and blocked states, keyed by card.id
cardWidth(contentWidth:) implements the locked clamp formula and is unit-tested at common iPhone widths

tasks.title: CardGalleryDebugView: legibility gate artifact (BLOCKING)
acceptance_criteria: Renders all 52 CardViews at the real cardWidth() output, from default Dynamic Type through accessibility1
Manual legibility pass recorded as PASS before any task depending on this one may start; a FAIL blocks T-022 onward and reopens T-019/T-020

tasks.title: DealOrchestrator / AnimationPlan pure planning layer + Reduce Motion branch
acceptance_criteria: dealFresh/transit are pure functions, unit-tested without any view hierarchy
Reduce Motion branch produces the strict 150ms opacity-only fade with zero translate/stagger, applied identically to deal/flip/transit

tasks.title: GameView + pile views + tap-to-move wiring + matchedGeometryEffect transit
acceptance_criteria: All selection/highlight/ambiguity rendering reads from GameEngine.interaction only, zero parallel @State booleans
Ambiguous-destination taps expose each legal destination as a discrete .accessibilityAction, not just a visual highlight
Deal/flip animation plays only on genuinely fresh deal (first launch or explicit New Game), never on a resumed cold launch

tasks.title: WinOverlay, StuckOverlay, DrawModeConfirmSheet
acceptance_criteria: WinOverlay and StuckOverlay are separate types, never a merged enum-driven overlay
New Game and draw-mode-change both route through the identical confirmation sheet component when a game is unfinished

tasks.title: StatsView + StatsModeFilter + EmptyStatePanel + DataLossPanel
acceptance_criteria: A never-played mode shows EmptyStatePanel (inviting icon/copy); a semantically-invalid restored stats file shows DataLossPanel (distinct icon, explicit data-loss copy, reset action) — the two are never visually interchangeable
bestTimeSeconds nil renders literally as 'N/A', never a fabricated or zero value

tasks.title: SettingsView + DrawModeSetting + CardBackPicker
acceptance_criteria: Card-back selection applies live with no confirmation; draw-mode change always routes through DrawModeConfirmSheet when a game is in progress
No draw-mode control exists anywhere on the Game screen
Local-data-is-not-backed-up disclosure copy present

tasks.title: SolitaireTabHost root TabView, gated by AppRestoreCoordinator
acceptance_criteria: App launches directly into resumed game or fresh deal with zero interstitial menu screen
First paint across all three tabs gated by the single hasFinishedInitialLoad flag

tasks.title: RecoveryBanner + ErrorToast components and wiring into Game/Settings failure paths
acceptance_criteria: Game-restore failure plays the normal deal animation then layers a dismissible RecoveryBanner after settling, never a blocking modal
Settings persistence fallback shows a lightweight ErrorToast, defaults are substituted and disclosed, never silently applied

tasks.title: App root wiring: DI, scenePhase handling, timer-freeze-before-flush ordering (integrator task)
acceptance_criteria: GameEngine, stores, and HapticsService are constructed once at the App root and injected via @Environment
On scenePhase .background: engine.freezeTimer() completes before GameSaveStore.flush() is invoked, verified by T-017's ordering test
This file is edited only via this task; no lane may add to it outside an explicit integration checkpoint

tasks.title: Accessibility identifiers/labels audit + performAccessibilityAudit() in UI tests
acceptance_criteria: Every custom-rendered view has an explicit accessibilityIdentifier for UI-test hooks, not just a VoiceOver label
performAccessibilityAudit() runs in the UI test suite and passes with zero violations
Suit color is never the only cue distinguishing red/black — a shape-level cue is present

tasks.title: XCUITest flows: cold launch deal, blocked-move feedback, both confirmation paths, Stats empty/data-loss states, no-overlap layout audit
acceptance_criteria: Every flow declared in flows-json has a corresponding passing XCUITest
No two text/control elements overlap on any screen in either light or dark appearance at default and accessibility1 Dynamic Type

tasks.title: Light/dark art-directed lighting scenes (felt, shadow, pewter tokens) — no card recoloring
acceptance_criteria: Light mode reads as daylight-through-a-window, dark mode as lamp-only-at-night, verified as genuinely distinct lighting narratives, not an inverted palette
Card front/back/ink colors are provably unchanged between appearances (same token references in both)
